submitted.rationale: I measured EQE at five compositions. Sb 0.39 gave 0.0047%, 0.50 gave 0.0187%, 0.543 gave 0.0240%, 0.58 gave 0.0183% and 0.65 gave 0.0140%. The response peaks clearly at Sb ≈ 0.54. That is Cu-rich next to CuSb2O6, where Cu3Sb4O12 (Sb 0.571) or a mixture of CuSb2O6 and a Cu oxide is likely to form.

rejected.reason: not measured; EQE was already falling from 0.58 toward 0.65, so these are unlikely to be better
